title: Correction
paragraphs: Proclamation 8894 of October 29, 2012--To Implement the United States-Panama Trade Promotion Agreement and for Other Purposes

In Presidential document 2012-27143 beginning on page 66507 in the issue of Monday, November 5, 2012, make the following correction: On page 66507, the proclamation identification heading on line one should read ``Proclamation 8894 of October 29, 2012''.
